items.one_liner: Chained CVE-2026-58073 and CVE-2026-58072 give unauthenticated RCE on Veeam Service Provider Console, requiring an immediate upgrade to 9.3.0.
items.summary: Bishop Fox has uncovered two critical vulnerabilities in the Veeam Service Provider Console (VSPC), tracked as CVE-2026-58073 (CVSS 9.5) and CVE-2026-58072 (CVSS 9.0). The first vulnerability allows an unauthenticated network peer to impersonate a managed backup agent and steal its certificate, while the second permits any entity holding an agent certificate to write arbitrary files on the server. Chained together, these flaws provide unauthenticated remote code execution on the central management server. Remediation requires upgrading to version 9.3.0, as no backport is available for 9.2.x builds, followed by log audits for indicators of compromise.
key_facts: CVE-2026-58073: CVSS v4.0 9.5, unauthenticated agent impersonation
CVE-2026-58072: CVSS v4.0 9.0, arbitrary file write leading to RCE
Affected versions: 9.2.1.33875 and all earlier version 9 builds
Remediation: Upgrade to version 9.3.0.35057 or later
items.bottom_line: Unauthenticated attackers can chain agent impersonation and arbitrary file write flaws in unpatched Veeam Service Provider Consoles to achieve full remote code execution.

items.title: Now everyone can put data to work
items.one_liner: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Work Data agent enables natural language querying of enterprise data sources with built-in permission enforcement.
items.summary: OpenAI has introduced a new 'Data agent' for ChatGPT Work, designed to allow enterprise users to query company data and generate interactive dashboards without writing SQL or using traditional BI tools. The agent integrates with various data sources like Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, while respecting existing enterprise permissions and security policies. It is currently being used by organizations to automate sales and spending analysis, with administrative controls available to manage data access and plugin configurations.
key_facts: Supported sources: Amazon Redshift, Datadog, Google BigQuery, ClickHouse, Databricks, MongoDB, Snowflake
items.bottom_line: Enterprises can now provide non-technical staff with direct, secure access to complex data analytics via natural language interfaces in ChatGPT.
